hero.subheadline: Saat hidup terasa dikawal tuntutan, tubuh sering tahu arah pulang sebelum fikiran berani mengakuinya.

empathy.headline: Untuk kamu yang terlalu lama kuat sendirian.
empathy.subheadline: Dari luar terlihat mampu. Di dalam, tubuh mungkin sudah lama meminta jeda.
paragraphs: Kamu tetap menjawab “baik”, walaupun tubuh sudah lelah terlebih dahulu.
Kalender penuh, kepala bising, tetapi sukar memberi ruang untuk diri sendiri.
Ada beban yang tidak hilang kerana terus ditahan sendirian.
Di sini, kamu belajar berhenti sebentar tanpa perlu menjelaskan semuanya.

items.text: Belajar melalui praktik langsung, bukan sekadar duduk mendengar materi.

items.title: Training yang Interaktif
items.text: Sesi berisi latihan, diskusi, dan proses bersama yang membuat peserta terlibat.

items.title: Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercise
items.text: Latihan terpandu untuk mengenali ketegangan tubuh dan melepaskannya perlahan-lahan.

photoProof.subheadline: Kamu akan bergerak, refleksi, berdiskusi, lalu pulang dengan rasa lebih ringan.

testimonials.headline: Apa yang peserta rasakan.
testimonials.subheadline: Cerita dari peserta yang merasakan ruang refleksi, latihan tubuh, dan proses bersama.

items.text: Ruang ini membantu saya mendengar tubuh dengan lebih lembut. Saya pulang dengan rasa yang lebih lapang.
items.name: Alya Rahman

items.text: Saya suka karena prosesnya tidak memaksa. Pelan, jelas, dan terasa aman untuk jujur.
items.name: Nadia Putri

items.text: Latihan refleksinya sederhana, tetapi membuka banyak hal yang selama ini saya simpan sendiri.
items.name: Mira Sofia

items.text: Diskusinya membuat saya sadar bahwa saya tidak perlu menyelesaikan semuanya sendirian.
items.name: Rania Yusuf

items.text: Trainer menjaga ruangan dengan tenang. Saya merasa dipandu, bukan dihakimi.
items.name: Dina Azzahra

items.text: Saya datang dengan kepala penuh. Saya pulang dengan satu langkah kecil yang terasa mungkin.
items.name: Sarah Lim

items.text: Workshop ini membantu saya menamai rasa yang sebelumnya hanya saya tahan di badan.
items.name: Fara Hassan

items.text: Saya paling ingat momen saat kami belajar berhenti sebentar tanpa merasa bersalah.
items.name: Liyana Noor

items.text: Prosesnya hangat dan manusiawi. Rasanya seperti diberi izin untuk pulang ke diri sendiri.
items.name: Aisha Tan

hero.eyebrow: The Inner Compass Workshop Batch 4 - Pekanbaru
hero.subheadline: When life feels driven by demands, your body often knows the way home before your mind can admit it.

empathy.headline: For you who have been strong alone for too long.
empathy.subheadline: On the outside, you look capable. Inside, your body may have been asking for pause.
paragraphs: You keep saying “I’m fine”, even when your body is already tired.
Your calendar is full and your head is loud, but rest still feels hard to choose.
Some weight does not disappear when it keeps being held alone.
Here, you learn to pause without needing to explain everything.

pillars.subheadline: Take the brave step, trust the process, and move toward your best self

items.title: Experienced & Professional Trainers
items.text: Guided by trainers who understand reflection, emotion, and group dynamics.

items.title: Experience-Based Training
items.text: Learn through direct practice, not only by sitting and listening to material.

items.title: Interactive Training
items.text: Sessions include exercises, discussion, and shared process that keep participants engaged.

items.title: Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercise
items.text: Guided practice to notice body tension and release it gently, step by step.

photoProof.headline: Feel the process.
photoProof.subheadline: You will move, reflect, discuss, and leave with a lighter sense of self.

testimonials.headline: What participants felt.
testimonials.subheadline: Participant reflections on safety, clarity, and the small shifts they carried home after the workshop.

items.text: The space helped me notice what my body had been saying quietly. I left feeling softer and more spacious.
items.name: Alya Rahman

items.text: Nothing felt rushed or forced. The process was gentle, clear, and safe enough for honesty.
items.name: Nadia Putri

items.text: The reflection exercises were simple, but they opened things I had been carrying alone.
items.name: Mira Sofia

items.text: The conversations reminded me that I do not have to figure everything out by myself.
items.name: Rania Yusuf

items.text: The trainers held the room with calm presence. I felt guided, not judged.
items.name: Dina Azzahra

items.text: I arrived with a crowded mind and left with one small next step that finally felt possible.
items.name: Sarah Lim

items.text: This workshop helped me name feelings I had only been holding in my body.
items.name: Fara Hassan

items.text: I still remember learning to pause without immediately feeling guilty for needing rest.
items.name: Liyana Noor

items.text: The process felt warm and human. It was like being given permission to come back to myself.
items.name: Aisha Tan

trainers.headline: Meet your workshop trainers.
trainers.subheadline: Two trainers hold the process with calm, clarity, and safety for honesty.

items.name: Tunku Nina Mansur
items.quote: We begin with what is felt in the body, not with a polished answer.

items.name: Jonelle Huang
items.quote: Not everything needs to be forced into completion. Sometimes it only needs to be heard first.

fasilitas.headline: What you will take home.
fasilitas.subheadline: Every participant leaves with more than just the experience itself.

items.title: Certificate
items.text: A participation certificate for every attendee.

items.title: TICW Pin
items.text: An exclusive pin as a symbol of your inner compass journey.

items.title: 2 Days of Training
items.text: Two full days of guided practice with experienced trainers.

items.title: Notebook + Pen
items.text: A notebook and pen to capture your personal reflections.

items.title: 1x Coffee Break / day
items.text: A daily coffee break to connect with other participants.

items.title: 1x Lunch / day
items.text: Lunch is provided to keep you energised through the session.
